sourceTitle: How Check Point accelerates vulnerability research with Daybreak
originalTitle: How Check Point accelerates vulnerability research with Daybreak
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: Check Point’s vulnerability research workflow used to take hours to complete. As part of the OpenAI Daybreak Defense Network, the company uses Daybreak to reduce that work to minutes, according to Jonathan Zanger, CTO of Check Point. Daybreak gives defenders access to OpenAI’s frontier cyber models that can analyze vulnerabilities, reason through attack paths, and identify security gaps in code and configurations.
blocks.en: Check Point’s vulnerability research workflow used to take hours to complete. As part of the OpenAI Daybreak Defense Network, the company uses Daybreak to reduce that work to minutes, according to Jonathan Zanger, CTO of Check Point. Daybreak gives defenders access to OpenAI’s frontier cyber models that can analyze vulnerabilities, reason through attack paths, and identify security gaps in code and configurations.
blocks.zh: 过去，Check Point 的漏洞研究流程需要数小时才能完成。据 Check Point 首席技术官 Jonathan Zanger 介绍，作为 OpenAI Daybreak 防御网络的成员，该公司借助 Daybreak 将这项工作的耗时缩短到了几分钟。Daybreak 让防御方能够使用 OpenAI 的前沿网络安全模型，分析漏洞、推演攻击路径，并识别代码和配置中的安全缺口。

blocks.text: Check Point helps secure over 100,000 organizations through its AI, workspace, cloud, and network security products. Check Point Research brings vulnerability research expertise to the company’s prevention-first approach, investigating emerging vulnerabilities and translating findings into protections for customers. Daybreak accelerates that research, shortening the path from understanding a vulnerability to developing a defense.
blocks.en: Check Point helps secure over 100,000 organizations through its AI, workspace, cloud, and network security products. Check Point Research brings vulnerability research expertise to the company’s prevention-first approach, investigating emerging vulnerabilities and translating findings into protections for customers. Daybreak accelerates that research, shortening the path from understanding a vulnerability to developing a defense.
blocks.zh: Check Point 通过 AI、工作空间、云和网络安全产品，为超过 10 万家组织提供安全防护。Check Point Research 团队凭借漏洞研究专长，调查新出现的漏洞，并将研究成果转化为面向客户的防护措施，支持公司以预防为先的安全策略。Daybreak 加快了这项研究，缩短了从理解漏洞到制定防御措施的过程。

blocks.text: “OpenAI is putting frontier cybersecurity intelligence in the hands of defenders and enabling companies like Check Point to turn this intelligence into threat prevention.”
blocks.en: “OpenAI is putting frontier cybersecurity intelligence in the hands of defenders and enabling companies like Check Point to turn this intelligence into threat prevention.”
blocks.zh: “OpenAI 正将前沿网络安全智能交到防御方手中，让 Check Point 这样的公司能够将这种智能转化为威胁预防能力。”

blocks.text: Turning vulnerability research into customer protection
blocks.en: Turning vulnerability research into customer protection
blocks.zh: 将漏洞研究转化为客户防护

blocks.text: “We’re seeing more cyber threats, and those threats are becoming increasingly sophisticated,” Zanger says. For Check Point, keeping pace means quickly turning information about newly disclosed vulnerabilities into protections for customers. “When a new vulnerability emerges, our job is to make sure our customers are protected against it as fast as possible.”
blocks.en: “We’re seeing more cyber threats, and those threats are becoming increasingly sophisticated,” Zanger says. For Check Point, keeping pace means quickly turning information about newly disclosed vulnerabilities into protections for customers. “When a new vulnerability emerges, our job is to make sure our customers are protected against it as fast as possible.”
blocks.zh: “我们看到的网络威胁越来越多，而且这些威胁也越来越复杂，”Zanger 表示。对 Check Point 而言，要跟上威胁的变化，就必须迅速将新披露的漏洞信息转化为客户防护措施。“当新漏洞出现时，我们的职责就是尽快确保客户得到保护，免受其害。”

blocks.text: That work depends on expert analysts who investigate vulnerabilities and translate their findings into security signatures or indicators of compromise that Check Point’s systems use to recognize threats. This research requires specialized expertise, and the team’s capacity was previously constrained by the number of analysts available to do it.
blocks.en: That work depends on expert analysts who investigate vulnerabilities and translate their findings into security signatures or indicators of compromise that Check Point’s systems use to recognize threats. This research requires specialized expertise, and the team’s capacity was previously constrained by the number of analysts available to do it.
blocks.zh: 这项工作依赖专业分析师：他们调查漏洞，将研究结果转化为安全特征或失陷指标，供 Check Point 的系统用于识别威胁。这类研究需要专业知识，而此前团队的研究能力受限于可投入这项工作的分析师人数。

blocks.text: Check Point uses OpenAI Daybreak to automate more of this workflow. “We leverage Daybreak to speed up and automate this process, and we can now do it in minutes instead of hours,” Zanger says. The value comes from the models’ ability to reason about security problems.
blocks.en: Check Point uses OpenAI Daybreak to automate more of this workflow. “We leverage Daybreak to speed up and automate this process, and we can now do it in minutes instead of hours,” Zanger says. The value comes from the models’ ability to reason about security problems.
blocks.zh: Check Point 使用 OpenAI Daybreak，让这一流程中的更多环节实现自动化。“我们利用 Daybreak 加速这一流程并实现自动化，现在只需几分钟就能完成，而不再需要数小时，”Zanger 表示。这种价值源于模型针对安全问题进行推理的能力。

blocks.text: “OpenAI Daybreak can understand vulnerabilities, analyze different attack patterns and scan the code to identify gaps.”
blocks.en: “OpenAI Daybreak can understand vulnerabilities, analyze different attack patterns and scan the code to identify gaps.”
blocks.zh: “OpenAI Daybreak 能够理解漏洞、分析不同的攻击模式，并扫描代码以识别安全缺口。”

blocks.text: Zanger also points to advances in understanding complex code and configurations, and identifying how systems could be exposed to attack. Check Point now considers those capabilities mature enough to incorporate into its cybersecurity workflows. For vulnerability research, Daybreak supports the investigative work that informs the development of a signature or indicator of compromise, giving analysts a faster path from understanding a threat to developing protections.
blocks.en: Zanger also points to advances in understanding complex code and configurations, and identifying how systems could be exposed to attack. Check Point now considers those capabilities mature enough to incorporate into its cybersecurity workflows. For vulnerability research, Daybreak supports the investigative work that informs the development of a signature or indicator of compromise, giving analysts a faster path from understanding a threat to developing protections.
blocks.zh: Zanger 还指出，模型在理解复杂代码和配置、识别系统可能遭受攻击的方式方面，也取得了进展。Check Point 如今认为，这些能力已足够成熟，可以融入其网络安全工作流程。在漏洞研究中，Daybreak 为调查工作提供支持，为制定安全特征或失陷指标提供依据，让分析师能够更快地从理解威胁迈向制定防护措施。

blocks.text: Developing autonomous network security with Daybreak
blocks.en: Developing autonomous network security with Daybreak
blocks.zh: 借助 Daybreak 构建自主网络安全防御

blocks.text: Check Point is also working with OpenAI to develop its Agentic Network Security Orchestration solution using Daybreak. The approach Zanger describes would combine continuous monitoring of customer environments with clearly defined operating boundaries and human approval for consequential actions. Customers would set their security objectives, and the system would explain its findings, recommended actions, and associated risks so they could decide how to proceed.
blocks.en: Check Point is also working with OpenAI to develop its Agentic Network Security Orchestration solution using Daybreak. The approach Zanger describes would combine continuous monitoring of customer environments with clearly defined operating boundaries and human approval for consequential actions. Customers would set their security objectives, and the system would explain its findings, recommended actions, and associated risks so they could decide how to proceed.
blocks.zh: Check Point 也正在与 OpenAI 合作，利用 Daybreak 开发其智能体网络安全编排解决方案。按照 Zanger 描述的方案，系统将持续监控客户环境，同时遵守明确的操作边界，并在执行影响重大的操作前获得人工批准。客户将设定安全目标，系统则会解释发现的问题、建议采取的措施及相关风险，以便客户决定下一步行动。

blocks.text: With vulnerability research now taking minutes to complete, Check Point’s next priority is remediation. The company is looking to use Daybreak’s capabilities to make it easier for their security teams to address the gaps they identify.
blocks.en: With vulnerability research now taking minutes to complete, Check Point’s next priority is remediation. The company is looking to use Daybreak’s capabilities to make it easier for their security teams to address the gaps they identify.
blocks.zh: 如今，漏洞研究只需几分钟就能完成，Check Point 下一步的重点是修复漏洞。该公司希望利用 Daybreak 的能力，让安全团队能够更轻松地修复发现的安全缺口。

blocks.text: “Combining OpenAI’s Daybreak with our existing security workflows unlocks a level of automation that can prevent threats in real time.”
blocks.en: “Combining OpenAI’s Daybreak with our existing security workflows unlocks a level of automation that can prevent threats in real time.”
blocks.zh: “将 OpenAI 的 Daybreak 与我们现有的安全工作流程相结合，能让自动化达到实时预防威胁的水平。”

blocks.text: For Check Point customers, faster research supports the development of protections against newly discovered vulnerabilities. With Daybreak, Check Point aims to extend that progress toward more autonomous defenses, with customers setting security objectives and approving consequential actions.
blocks.en: For Check Point customers, faster research supports the development of protections against newly discovered vulnerabilities. With Daybreak, Check Point aims to extend that progress toward more autonomous defenses, with customers setting security objectives and approving consequential actions.
blocks.zh: 对 Check Point 的客户而言，更快的研究有助于开发针对新发现漏洞的防护措施。借助 Daybreak，Check Point 希望在这些进展的基础上实现更自主的防御，同时由客户设定安全目标，并批准影响重大的操作。
